## 🚀 Pull Request Overview

Thank you for contributing to WebMuseum!

Tell us briefly what you've changed.

## 📝 What did you change?

Describe your contribution in simple words.

## 🎯 Why is this change needed?

What problem does it solve, or how does it improve WebMuseum?

## 🔗 Related Issue

Does this pull request fix or relate to an existing issue?

Closes #

If there is no related issue, you can leave this blank.

## 📸 Screenshots (If Applicable)

If you've changed the design or user interface, please add before-and-after screenshots.

## ✅ Contributor Checklist

Before submitting, please check:

- [ ] I have tested my changes locally.
- [ ] My changes do not break existing features.
- [ ] `npm run build` completes successfully.
- [ ] I have followed the project's coding conventions.
- [ ] I have not included unnecessary files or credentials.
- [ ] I have added screenshots if my changes affect the UI.

## 💬 Anything Else?

Add any additional information that maintainers should know.
